proof_scope: Runtime-artifact safety (#1440): (a) containment -- reject a path that escapes the allowed root even when the lexical string looks contained (symlink / .. traversal); (b) an owner(PID)+TTL runtime lock that recovers a crashed writer's stale lock on evidence but never steals an ACTIVE lock; and (c) storage relocation -- a default live bridge run writes its runtime-value-bearing status OUTSIDE the git worktree (under $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/agent-skills-debugger/<workspace-hash>/) leaving zero new debugger-bridge worktree entries, and a request that targets a NON-git-ignored workspace path is refused by name with no file created there. Live cases are capability-gated on an open, trusted VS Code workspace with the bridge.

claims.proves: debugger_runtime_guard.py enforces realpath containment and evidence-based lock recovery; and the live bridge stores paused-value status under the OS runtime dir by default (worktree untouched) while refusing unprotected workspace-local artifact paths (no leak file, named refusal)
claims.does_not_prove: storage behavior on Remote SSH hosts, or redaction quality of captured values (secret-redaction.json owns capture-side redaction)

cases.name: reject-symlink-escape
cases.description: A path through a symlink that points outside the root is rejected, even though its string is under the root.
command: set -uo pipefail; SKILL="$(cd .. && pwd)"; T=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p "$T/root" "$T/outside"; echo secret > "$T/outside/target.txt"; ln -s "$T/outside" "$T/root/escape"; python3 "$SKILL/scripts/debugger_runtime_guard.py" check-containment "$T/root" "$T/root/escape/target.txt"

cases.name: reject-dotdot-traversal
cases.description: A ..-traversal path resolving outside the root is rejected.
command: set -uo pipefail; SKILL="$(cd .. && pwd)"; T=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p "$T/root" "$T/outside"; echo secret > "$T/outside/target.txt"; python3 "$SKILL/scripts/debugger_runtime_guard.py" check-containment "$T/root" "$T/root/../outside/target.txt"

cases.name: accept-contained-path
cases.description: A genuinely contained path resolves inside the root and is accepted.
command: set -uo pipefail; SKILL="$(cd .. && pwd)"; T=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p "$T/root"; touch "$T/root/real.txt"; python3 "$SKILL/scripts/debugger_runtime_guard.py" check-containment "$T/root" "$T/root/real.txt"

cases.name: refuse-active-lock
cases.description: A lock held by a live owner within its TTL is NOT stolen -- acquisition is refused.
command: set -uo pipefail; SKILL="$(cd .. && pwd)"; T=$(mktemp -d); LK="$T/run.lock"; python3 "$SKILL/scripts/debugger_runtime_guard.py" lock-write "$LK" --pid $$ --age-seconds 1 --ttl 300 >/dev/null; python3 "$SKILL/scripts/debugger_runtime_guard.py" lock-acquire "$LK" --ttl 30

cases.name: recover-stale-lock-dead-owner
cases.description: A lock whose owner PID is not alive is recovered (not silently deleted -- recovered on dead-owner evidence).
command: set -uo pipefail; SKILL="$(cd .. && pwd)"; T=$(mktemp -d); LK="$T/run.lock"; python3 "$SKILL/scripts/debugger_runtime_guard.py" lock-write "$LK" --pid 999999 --age-seconds 1 --ttl 300 >/dev/null; python3 "$SKILL/scripts/debugger_runtime_guard.py" lock-acquire "$LK" --ttl 30

cases.name: default-storage-leaves-worktree-clean
cases.description: A default live bridge stop writes its paused-value status under $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR (not the worktree): the frame and locals are read back from the runtime dir, and git sees zero new debugger-bridge entries.
command: set -uo pipefail; export UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="${UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT:-/mnt/storage12tb/skills/debugger/.venv}"; export UV_LINK_MODE=copy; WS="${DEBUGGER_VSCODE_WORKSPACE:-}"; [ -z "$WS" ] && { echo BRIDGE_BLOCKED; exit 0; }; BEFORE=$(git -C "$WS" status --porcelain | grep -c debugger-bridge || true); OUT=$(uv run --project .. python ../scripts/request_vscode_bridge.py --workspace "$WS" --action restart --launch-config-name 'Debugger walkthrough ($debugger)' --break "$WS/skills/debugger/scenarios/variable_state/main.py:20" --local first --stop-timeout-ms 30000 --expect-extension-host-kind ui | tail -1); echo "status-path: $OUT"; case "$OUT" in ${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-/tmp}/agent-skills-debugger/*) echo OUT-IS-RUNTIME-DIR;; *) echo OUT-NOT-RUNTIME-DIR; exit 1;; esac; for i in $(seq 1 75); do sleep 2; S=$(python3 -c "import json;print(json.load(open('$OUT')).get('status'))" 2>/dev/null || echo pending); case "$S" in stopped|stopped-not-proof|error|terminated) break;; esac; done; echo "final-status=$S"; [ "$S" = stopped ] || { echo BRIDGE_BLOCKED; exit 0; }; python3 -c "import json;d=json.load(open('$OUT'));ss=d['stoppedState'];print('locals:',ss['locals'])"; AFTER=$(git -C "$WS" status --porcelain | grep -c debugger-bridge || true); [ "$BEFORE" = "$AFTER" ] && echo WORKTREE-CLEAN || { echo WORKTREE-DIRTIED; exit 1; }

cases.name: refuses-unprotected-workspace-output
cases.description: A request whose output targets a NON-git-ignored workspace path is refused: no file is created there, and the refusal is named in a bridge-dir status.
command:
set -uo pipefail; WS="${DEBUGGER_VSCODE_WORKSPACE:-}"; [ -z "$WS" ] && { echo BRIDGE_BLOCKED; exit 0; }; LEAK="$WS/docs/debugger-status-leak-eval.json"; python3 - "$WS" <<'PYEOF'
import json, hashlib, sys, uuid
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
ws = Path(sys.argv[1])
req = {
  "id": f"debugger-{uuid.uuid4()}", "action": "restart", "workspace": str(ws),
  "launchConfigName": "Debugger walkthrough ($debugger)",
  "breakpoints": [{"file": str(ws / "skills/debugger/scenarios/variable_state/main.py"), "line": 20}],
  "removeBreakpoints": [], "locals": ["first"], "watches": [], "allowWatchEval": False,
  "output": "docs/debugger-status-leak-eval.json",
  "stopTimeoutMs": 20000, "replaceBreakpoints": True, "saveBeforeStart": False,
  "createdAt": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), "maxRequestAgeMs": 120000,
  "expectedExtensionHostKind": "ui",
}
payload = json.dumps({k: v for k, v in req.items() if k != "requestHash"}, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"))
req["requestHash"] = hashlib.sha256(payload.encode()).hexdigest()
(ws / ".vscode/debugger-bridge/request.json").write_text(json.dumps(req, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
PYEOF
found=''; for i in $(seq 1 20); do sleep 2; if grep -rls 'refuses workspace-local' "$WS/.vscode/debugger-bridge" >/dev/null 2>&1; then found=yes; break; fi; done; [ -f "$LEAK" ] && { echo LEAK-FILE-EXISTS; exit 1; }; echo NO-LEAK-FILE; [ -n "$found" ] && echo REFUSAL-NAMED || { echo BRIDGE_BLOCKED; exit 0; }

cases.name: recover-stale-lock-expired-ttl
cases.description: A lock whose TTL has expired is recovered even if its owner is still alive.
command: set -uo pipefail; SKILL="$(cd .. && pwd)"; T=$(mktemp -d); LK="$T/run.lock"; python3 "$SKILL/scripts/debugger_runtime_guard.py" lock-write "$LK" --pid $$ --age-seconds 999 --ttl 30 >/dev/null; python3 "$SKILL/scripts/debugger_runtime_guard.py" lock-acquire "$LK" --ttl 30
